0022600164.text: The Dallas Mavericks (4-2, on a three-game winning streak and 6th in the West) host the Sacramento Kings (0-6, on a six-game losing streak and 15th in the West) in Dallas's seventh game of the season. Dallas is without Dereck Lively II (foot surgery), Santi Aldama (knee surgery), Sergio de Larrea (knee strain) and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation), while Sacramento is missing Ben Simmons (Achilles surgery), Dylan Cardwell (calf strain), Keegan Murray (ankle) and Maxime Raynaud (dislocated knee). The teams have not played each other yet in 2026-27, and in 2025-26 the Mavericks lost the series 1-2, most recently falling 130-121 in Dallas on February 26.
